encode_text_with_gpt2_bpe: encode a string into GPT2 BPE token IDs using the GPT2BPE encode method
decode_gpt2_bpe_tokens: decode a space-separated string of GPT2 BPE token IDs back into text
check_beginning_of_word: check if a GPT2 BPE token is the beginning of a word using is_beginning_of_word
configure_gpt2_bpe_encoder: configure the GPT2BPEConfig dataclass with custom encoder.json and vocab.bpe file paths
initialize_gpt2_bpe: initialize a GPT2BPE instance with a config to load the GPT2 BPE encoder and vocab
